purpose: Source-only prospective input feasibility; no 666-row corpus, features, predictions, labels or training admission created.

definitions.q: original reference r + fixed offset; same q for before/after
definitions.context: Finite non-sentinel exact8 query minmax, un-clipped/unexpanded, positive x/y extent required; (-1,-1) only sentinel.
definitions.L: clip(0.25*max(ptp(finite non-sentinel q8, axis=0)),16,max(H,W)); fewer2 valid finite=>16; centroid excluded; finite OOB retained.

slot0_emulation_from_BEFORE_only.proposal: Keep actual BEFORE/AFTER q8/L/bbox metadata immutable. New emulated tuple = original BEFORE q8 copy with fixed slot0 replaced by r+offset; slots1..7 unchanged. Freeze this SAME new tuple/context/L for BOTH views. Slot0 is only a prospective input carrier, not native-part identity or GT-best matching.
slot0_emulation_from_BEFORE_only.query_grid_point_native_image_support: All333 q are in native RGB domain. Existing OOB q1..7 remain; context validity must be sampled factually with normal zero padding, never clipped or relabeled.

rejected_view_specific_tuple_shortcut.explanation: Do not independently build emulated context/L from AFTER q1..7; actual occluder-dependent detector shifts can encode label and destroy matched context.

recommendation_KO: 고정 BEFORE q1..7 + 별도 emulated q0=r+offset의 새8점 tuple을 만들고, 배포와 동일한 unclipped minmax context와 V60 L 공식을 이 tuple에 적용한 뒤 두 view에 똑같이 공유하는 구성이 가장 단순합니다. 원래 actual q8/L은 별도 provenance로 그대로 둡니다. 재계산 L은21.9474~129.3546px이며 원 BEFORE L 대비0.9716~1.0329배입니다. 원 BEFORE L을 그대로 공유해도 모든 r가 central32와 uncertainty가 full96 안에 들어가지만, 새 tuple에서 L을 계산하는 배포 정의와 달라집니다. 따라서 exact operator 일치를 우선하면 재계산 L을 권고합니다. 이는 새로운 source emulation이며 실제 initializer 성능·정확한 native corner·인간 gold로 승격하지 않습니다.
limitations: Reference r remains a weak AI structural-cue localization with original uncertainty/registration caveats. The grid is a query proposal, not nine exact true corners.
Labels concern expected cue-region visibility under the existing weak observation; they do not assert visible pallet material at every q.
Fixed carrier slot0 can remove original q0 extremal geometry; it is a declared emulation convention, not recovered part association.
BEFORE-derived tuple reused on AFTER is controlled paired emulation, not the original AFTER initializer output.
All333 reference centres fit central32 geometrically; the whole uncertainty box fits central32 in only the reported subset. No visual cue or pixel quality claim is inferred from geometry.
Future frozen-C14 baseline diagnosis should retain all666 and original folds, with no model choice or training.
